Yuki: Heads-up: mobile webview quickstart shows duplicated chunks after auth refresh + reconnect. Repro: start stream, force token refresh, background app for ~3s, foreground -> UI renders duplicated sentences.
Sam: which SDK/version?
Yuki: android-webview-sdk v0.7.4 from sample-apps. Node/browser repros different.
Jordan: can you paste raw capture?
Yuki: captured buffer: ```data: {"id":"m1","chunk":"Hello"}

data: {"id":"m1","chunk":" world"}

data: {"id":"m1","chunk":" world"}
``` second " world" is duplicate after reconnect. Looks like resend + resume overlap.
Sam: sounds like our smart-routing retry fired while KV-cache resume replayed same tokens. Mobile reconnects can trigger both.
Jordan: temp fix for sample-app: disable automatic retry on auth-refresh for streaming endpoints, or make retries idempotent using chunk ids.
Yuki: good call. Also onboarding doc should warn about webview backgrounding during token refresh tests.
qa-bot: Created ticket QA/PROD-981: "mobile-webview: stream duplicate chunks on auth refresh + reconnect"
ci-bot: Created issue devex/sample-apps#2837: "webview quickstart: duplicated chunks after token refresh"
Sam: longer-term SDK change: attach monotonic sequence numbers per logical chunk and dedupe on client reassembly. Also ensure server-side retry uses resume token instead of blind resend.
Jordan: I'll prototype client-side dedupe by chunk id and add unit tests simulating concurrent retry+resume.
Yuki: thanks. This should reduce onboarding churn for mobile demos. :+1:
